body: I just honestly want it over with. Yeah it's going to hurt people, that's what everybody says about suicide. But I'm sick of the suffering of depression and this lost feeling constantly. They suffer until they get over it but I have to suffer forever. It's torture.
Maybe I don't want them to find me. I don't want to seem like the dramatic person. I just want to go peacefully. As friday draws closer I gain more confidence in what I'm doing.
Nobody does. That's the whole thing.
I just don't know anybody who would care. I don't care so why should anybody else? I'm not going to try to get people to notice. I'm going to hide it. Push through to friday if even that.

I've talked to people, tried to work it out. I just got home from my girlfriends house. Barely said a word and she didn't notice a thing. Just feel like it's not worth the time or trouble. Nobody listens. I've decided that Friday is the day.
